title: A 3D Cell Culture Model Identifies Wnt/β‐Catenin Mediated Inhibition of p53 as a Critical Step during Human Hepatocyte Regeneration

evidence_spans.quote: Here, a 3D spheroid model of PHH is established to study hepatocyte regeneration
experimental methods to expand primary human hepatocytes (PHH)
its proliferative senescence-inducing target PAI1 (SERPINE1)
integrative time-lapse multi-omics analyses

scope_reviewer.uncertainty_reason: The abstract uses a generic multi-omics label without naming molecular layers, and mentions a senescence-inducing target without showing that a senescent state or another aging construct was analyzed.
scope_reviewer.concise_rationale: This is an original biological study of primary human hepatocyte regeneration. Aging relevance is unresolved because senescence appears only as a modifier of PAI1, while the reported analyses concern regeneration and proliferation.

causal_design_reviewer.estimand_or_contrast: Wnt activation was reported to inhibit p53/PAI1 and drive proliferation of >50% of PHH.

title: Large language model-based biological age prediction in large-scale populations

evidence_spans.quote: Here we propose a framework
six population-based cohorts, encompassing over 10 million participants
to estimate individual overall and organ-specific aging
LLM-predicted overall age
identify proteomic biomarkers associated with accelerated aging

scope_reviewer.concise_rationale: This primary cohort analysis models overall and organ-specific biological aging and analyzes proteomic biomarkers, but the other molecular proxies are benchmark comparators rather than underlying omics measurements used in the report.

causal_design_reviewer.outcome: All-cause mortality; organ-specific diseases; aging-related phenotypes and health outcomes.
causal_design_reviewer.estimand_or_contrast: Predictive performance of LLM-predicted age versus other aging proxies and machine-learning models.
